Celebrate the beauty of human experiences with us. Create with love for nature for a happier, healthier life of people. Together, with warmth and modesty, we deliver food innovations, create inspiring scents and develop solutions that make people look good and feel good. With more than 17,000 employees worldwide, who explore ideas and goals together, there is much to learn and many from which we can learn. Dive into a varied, flexible and stimulating environment.

Meet professionals with real powers to work together, make friends and expand your skills. Every day your energy, creativity and determination shape our future and affect billions of people positively. Each part of you is an enrichment for our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

For our production site in Dübendorf we are looking for an engaged person as Industrial Automation Project Engineer(m/f/d).

In this exciting position, you support the existing engineering team. You will gain your sound expertise in an ongoing major project in the areas of automation technology, electrical engineering, process safety and IT/OT in general directly on site and assume the responsibility of a central part of the project starting from the Detail Design phase.

You work in a production-oriented environment at the Dübendorf site and you are directly rapporting to the site En,gi,nee,ring Manager.

Main tasks & Project Responsibility Automation

MSRL & Automation Engineering: Creation, revision and extension of MSRL lists, function descriptions and source & effect diagrams

Process reliability; execution and post-processing of process risk analyses as well as integration of safety integrity levels (SIL) and performance levels (PL).

Process technology: Dealing with regulatory issues during the selection and commissioning of a wide range of instruments and fittings.

Understanding and extending process flow images / R&Is.

Plant construction: coordination of external trades and technical challenges of solutions in the field of automation and electrical engineering proposed by the technical planners.

Installation & commissioning: Planning and guiding of the activities on site, coordination of the assembly and monitoring/co-ordination/implementation of the commissioning of the process plants.

Electrical

Coordination and support of internal and external trades

Read and interpret electro-schema

Instrumentation & Field Engineering: Asking about the instruments selected by the specialist planner and working out the most optimal solution for each application

IT/OT

Ensuring compliance with global Givaudan IT/OT standards in the ongoing project

Creation and execution of an automation concept taking into account all internal and legal requirements and including all stakeholders' requirements.

Monitoring the commissioning of measuring and control instruments in the process environment.

Your professional profile

Graduated studies (Uni/FH) Subject of automation technology, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics or comparable. Knowledge of process technology or industrial process systems is of benefit.

Experience: At least 5 years of experience as an automation project engineer in industrial plant engineering / project engineer / field engineer (prefers food, chemical or pharmaceutical industry).

Automation & Security: Detection of practice in the creation/extension of MSRL lists, instrument selection and knowledge in the handling of process security, technical data (SIL, performance level).

Software: Ideally experience in handling the Siemens TIA Portal, WinCC, Simatic S7. Good knowledge of Autodesk AutoCAD (2D & P&ID) is an advantage. Secure knowledge MS Office.

Working method: Self-employed, structured and goal-oriented working methods in the execution of parallel project phases.

Languages: German and English in word and writing.

Process technology: Ideally already experience in spray drying.

Additional information

The work place is Dübendorf. Due to the production-related project execution and for upcoming commissioning a predominantly on-site presence is required.

Working time mainly sliding (returning to be taken into account)

Integration into well-positioned engineering team (6 people) with open communication, communication, culture

What additional benefits do we offer?

Interesting development and training opportunities

40 hours week

Additional paid days

Advantageous pension funds Conditions

Reduced meals in the staff restaurant

Sports and leisure activities in the Givaudan Sports Club (showers on site)

Discount in the employee shop in Kemptthal

Free company parking and bike port

REKA Checks and SBB Half-tax participation

Free drinks (water, coffee, tea)

Worldwide private accident coverage and free hospital choice

The costs of Givaudan for accident insurance and additional insurance contributions

Additional voluntary family and training allowances

We appreciate the different perspectives that arise from diverse cultures, backgrounds and experiences. Each person – regardless of ethnic origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion or personal circumstances – is welcome at Givaudan, a place where we all like to be and grow.

Every part of you is an enrichment for our world. Join in and shape a better future together with us.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Process (h/f/d)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez-nous et célébrons ensemble la beauté de l’expérience humaine. Participez à la création pour des vies plus heureuses et plus saines, avec l’amour de la nature. Ensemble, avec bienveillance, humilité et l'esprit d’aventure, nous proposons des innovations pour l’alimentation, concevons des parfums inspirés et développons des solutions pour la beauté et le bien-être. Il y a tant de choses à découvrir au sein de nos 79 sites de production répartis dans le monde entier et célèbres pour leurs processus et procédures de pointe. Tant de choses à apprendre auprès de leaders brillants et de collègues attentionnés avec qui explorer vos idées et propulser vos ambitions. Chaque jour, votre énergie, votre personnalité et votre détermination façonneront notre avenir et feront la différence pour des milliards de personnes. Notre monde s’enrichit de vos différences. Nous sommes Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Ingénieur Process (h/f/d) - Votre prochain emploi ?

En qualité de**Ingénieur Process (h/f/d)** à **Vernier**, vous êtes rattaché à notre usine de **Production Composition** et vous rapportez à notre **Manager de production**. Vous serez en charge d'identifier et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives d’amélioration concernant la fabrication, les équipments de production, les flux de matières, l’optimisation des matières, l’efficacité et les stocks afin d’atteindre les objectifs de coûts, de qualité et de production.

Ce poste vous intéresse ? Cela pourrait être l’opportunité parfaite si, comme pour nous, votre objectif est de toujours répondre aux besoins des clients et de toucher les émotions du monde qui vous entoure.

## Votre Principale Mission :

- Analyser les données process et les indicateurs de performance afin d’identifier des axes d’amélioration, de fiabilisation et d’optimisation des procédés.
- Piloter des démarches de résolution de problèmes techniques, identifier et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations.
- Définir et mettre en oeuvre des actions d’amélioration en fonction des contraintes sécurité, opérationnelles, qualité et coûts.
- Optimiser les consommations de matières premières et les paramètres de production dans une logique de performance industrielle et d’amélioration continue.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a noi e celebra insieme la bellezza dell'esperienza umana. Partecipa alla creazione per una vita più felice e più sana, con l'amore della natura. Insieme, con benevolenza, umiltà e spirito d'avventura, proponiamo innovazioni per il cibo, progettando fragranze ispirate e sviluppando soluzioni per bellezza e benessere. Ci sono così tante cose da scoprire nei nostri 79 siti produttivi in tutto il mondo e famosi per i loro processi e procedure all'avanguardia. Tanto da imparare da leader brillanti e colleghi riflessivi con cui esplorare le vostre idee e guidare le vostre ambizioni. Ogni giorno, la vostra energia, personalità e determinazione plasmano il nostro futuro e fanno la differenza per miliardi di persone. Il nostro mondo è arricchito dalle vostre differenze. Siamo Givaudan. Umano per natura.

## Process Engineer (h/f/d) - Il tuo prossimo lavoro?

Come Ingegnere di Processo (h/f/d) a Vernier, siete attaccati al nostro impianto Composizione di Produzione e riferite al nostro Production Manager. Sarà incaricato di individuare e implementare iniziative di miglioramento nella produzione, nelle attrezzature di produzione, nei flussi materiali, nell'ottimizzazione dei materiali, nell'efficienza e nell'inventario per raggiungere obiettivi di costo, qualità e produzione.

Ti interessa questo lavoro? Questa potrebbe essere l'occasione perfetta se, come per noi, il vostro obiettivo è quello di soddisfare sempre le esigenze dei clienti e toccare le emozioni del mondo intorno a voi.

## La vostra missione principale:

- Analizzare i dati di processo e gli indicatori di performance per identificare le indicazioni per il miglioramento del processo, l'affidabilità e l'ottimizzazione.
- Il problema tecnico pilota risolve approcci, identifica e implementa miglioramenti.
- Identificare e implementare azioni per migliorare alla luce dei vincoli di sicurezza, operativi, qualità e costi.
- Ottimizzare il consumo di materie prime e i parametri di produzione in una logica di prestazioni industriali e miglioramento continuo.
- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di produzione, manutenzione, qualità, HSE, SMEL, automazione e ingegneria su tematiche tecniche trasversali.
- Partecipa a progetti tecnici come riferimento di processo, in collaborazione con i team Engineering & Maintenance.
- Scrivere le specifiche URS/funzionali e contribuire a definire i requisiti tecnici delle installazioni e attrezzature.
- Fornire un supporto chiave su temi di affidabilità industriale e automazione dei processi.
- Assicurarsi che vengano presi in considerazione i vincoli associati alle zone ATEX e la sicurezza dei processi industriali.
- Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo e alla diffusione di buone pratiche sul sito.

- Hai almeno 3 anni di esperienza in una funzione simile idealmente in un ambiente di produzione chimico o petrolchimico. Hai un'esperienza confermata nel cambiamento di guida e potrai accompagnare progetti di miglioramento in ambienti esigenti, dinamici e in continua evoluzione;
- Hai forti competenze tecniche legate ai processi produttivi e sono confortevoli nell'analisi e nella risoluzione di complesse problematiche industriali;
- Miglioramento continuo orientato, padroneggiate le metodologie Lean Manufacturing e/o Six Sigma. La certificazione di prestito è un bene;
- Hai un ottimo comando di SAP e hai una buona conoscenza di strumenti informatici come Microsoft Office. La padronanza degli strumenti di modellazione del flusso è un plus;
- Hai un comando perfetto del francese e un ottimo comando dell'inglese (minimo B2);
- Siete particolarmente riconosciuti per la vostra capacità di analizzare e sfruttare i dati industriali per supportare il processo decisionale e l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni;
- Apprezzi il lavoro di taglio incrociato e sai come collaborare efficacemente con vari interlocutori;
- Rigoury, pragmatico e dotato di un buon rapporto, si è in grado di combinare visione del campo e approccio analitico;

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join us and celebrate together the beauty of the human experience. Participate in creation for happier and healthier lives, with the love of nature. Together, with benevolence, humility and adventure spirit, we propose innovations for food, design inspired fragrances and develop solutions for beauty and well-being. There are so many things to discover at our 79 production sites worldwide and famous for their cutting-edge processes and procedures. So much to learn from brilliant leaders and thoughtful colleagues with whom to explore your ideas and drive your ambitions. Every day, your energy, personality and determination will shape our future and make a difference for billions of people. Our world is enriched by your differences. We're Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Process Engineer (h/f/d) - Your next job?

As a Process Engineer (h/f/d) to Vernier, you are attached to our Production Composition plant and you report to our Production Manager. You will be in charge of identifying and implementing improvement initiatives in manufacturing, production equipment, material flows, material optimization, efficiency and inventory to achieve cost, quality and production objectives.

You're interested in this job? This could be the perfect opportunity if, as for us, your goal is to always meet the needs of customers and touch the emotions of the world around you.

## Your Main Mission:

- Analyze process data and performance indicators to identify directions for process improvement, reliability and optimization.
- Pilot technical problem solving approaches, identify and implement improvements.
- Identify and implement actions to improve in the light of security, operational, quality and cost constraints.
- Optimize raw material consumption and production parameters in a logic of industrial performance and continuous improvement.
- Work closely with production, maintenance, quality, HSE, SMEL, automation and engineering teams on transversal technical topics.
- Participate in technical projects as a process reference, in conjunction with Engineering & Maintenance teams.
- Write down the URS/functional specifications and help define the technical requirements of the installations and equipment.
- Provide key support on topics of industrial reliability and process automation.
- Ensure that the constraints associated with ATEX zones and the safety of industrial processes are taken into account.
- Actively contribute to continuous improvement and dissemination of good practice on the site.

You? Want to evolve and shape your career in your own way? Do you want to integrate a company that promotes teamwork? Would you like to collaborate and learn with a team as qualified as they are passionate about their profession? Then join us and make your career meaningful! Give us your complete file, CV, Letter of motivation, diploma! Your Profile:

- You are in receipt of an engineering degree ideally in chemical engineering or equivalent training;
- You have at least 3 years experience in a similar function ideally in a chemical or petrochemical production environment. You have a confirmed experience in leading change and are able to accompany improvement projects in demanding, dynamic and constantly changing environments;
- You have strong technical skills related to production processes and are comfortable in analyzing and resolving complex industrial issues;
- Oriented continuous improvement, you master the Lean Manufacturing and/or Six Sigma methodologies. Lean certification is an asset;
- You have excellent command of SAP and you have very good knowledge of computer tools such as Microsoft Office. The mastery of flow modelling tools is a plus;
- You have a perfect command of French and a very good command of English (minimum B2);
- You are particularly recognized for your ability to analyze and exploit industrial data to support decision-making and performance optimization;
- You appreciate the cross-cutting work and know how to collaborate effectively with various interlocutors;
- Rigoury, pragmatic and endowed with a good relational, you are able to combine field vision and analytical approach;
- You demonstrate a proactive attitude to changes and ongoing improvements to the site.

For safety and hygiene reasons, please note that wearing the beard is not allowed in the production/laboratory functions.

By virtue of its activities, Givaudan is subject to the regulations of OFAC (Federal Civil Aviation Office). In this context, we inform you that an extract of the criminal record will be required at the end of the recruitment process.

- Participation in the sickness insurance premium
- Beneficial pension fund
- Personnel store, access to Givaudan products
- Sports and leisure activities
- Business restaurant with discounted prices
- Mobility grant

At Givaudan, you help create taste and olfactory experiences that delight people's lives. We value the different perspectives that arise from different cultures, backgrounds and experiences. Every person — whatever their origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion or personal situation — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we love to be and grow together.

Our world is enriched by your differences. Join us.

## Process Engineer (h/f/d) - Ihr nächster Job?

Als Prozessingenieur (h/w/d) bis Vernier sind Sie an unsere Produktionskomposition Anlage angeschlossen und berichten an unseren Produktionsleiter. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Identifizierung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsinitiativen in Produktion, Produktionsausrüstung, Materialflüssen, Materialoptimierung, Effizienz und Lagerbestand, um Kosten-, Qualitäts- und Produktionsziele zu erreichen.

Sie interessieren sich für diesen Job? Dies könnte die perfekte Gelegenheit sein, wenn es für uns Ihr Ziel ist, immer die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu erfüllen und die Emotionen der Welt um Sie herum zu berühren.

## Ihre Hauptmission:

- Analysieren Sie Prozessdaten und Leistungsindikatoren, um Richtungen für Prozessverbesserung, Zuverlässigkeit und Optimierung zu identifizieren.
- Pilotierung technischer Problemlösungsansätze, Identifizierung und Implementierung von Verbesserungen.
- Ermittlung und Durchführung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Sicherheit, des Betriebs, der Qualität und der Kosten.
- Optimieren Sie Rohstoffverbrauch und Produktionsparameter in einer Logik der industriellen Leistung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktions-, Wartungs-, Qualitäts-, HSE-, SMEL-, Automatisierungs- und Engineering-Teams zu transversalen technischen Themen.
- Beteiligen Sie sich an technischen Projekten als Prozessreferenz in Verbindung mit Engineering & Maintenance Teams.
- Notieren Sie sich die URS / Funktionsspezifikationen und helfen Sie, die technischen Anforderungen der Anlagen und Ausrüstungen zu definieren.
- Bieten Sie wichtige Unterstützung bei Themen der industriellen Zuverlässigkeit und Prozessautomatisierung.
- Gewährleistung, dass die mit den ATEX-Zonen verbundenen Einschränkungen und die Sicherheit industrieller Prozesse berücksichtigt werden.
- Aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Verbreitung bewährter Praktiken auf der Website beitragen.

Sie haben eine bestätigte Erfahrung in der Führung von Veränderungen und sind in der Lage, Verbesserungsprojekte in anspruchsvollen, dynamischen und sich ständig verändernden Umgebungen zu begleiten;
- Sie haben starke technische Fähigkeiten in Bezug auf Produktionsprozesse und sind komfortabel in der Analyse und Lösung komplexer industrieller Probleme;
- Orientierte kontinuierliche Verbesserung, beherrschen Sie die Lean Manufacturing und / oder Six Sigma Methoden. Lean-Zertifizierung ist ein Vermögenswert;
- Sie beherrschen SAP hervorragend und kennen sich mit Computertools wie Microsoft Office bestens aus. Die Beherrschung von Strömungsmodellierungswerkzeugen ist ein Plus;
- Sie haben ein perfektes Französisch und ein sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens B2);
- Sie sind besonders für Ihre Fähigkeit bekannt, industrielle Daten zu analysieren und zu nutzen, um Entscheidungsfindung und Leistungsoptimierung zu unterstützen;
- Sie schätzen die Querschnittsarbeit und wissen, wie Sie effektiv mit verschiedenen Gesprächspartnern zusammenarbeiten können;
- Strenge, pragmatisch und mit einer guten Beziehung ausgestattet, sind Sie in der Lage, Field Vision und analytischen Ansatz zu kombinieren;
- Sie zeigen eine proaktive Einstellung zu Änderungen und laufenden Verbesserungen der Website.

- Beteiligung an der Krankenversicherungsprämie
- Begünstigter Pensionsfonds

- Business Restaurant mit ermäßigten Preisen
- Mobilitätszuschuss

Bei Givaudan tragen Sie dazu bei, Geschmacks- und Geruchserlebnisse zu schaffen, die das Leben der Menschen erfreuen. Jeder Mensch - unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Kultur, Religion oder persönlicher Situation - wird in Givaudan herzlich willkommen geheißen, einem Ort, an dem wir gerne zusammen sind und wachsen.

**Naturex AG, azienda del Gruppo Givaudan**, è un fornitore leader mondiale di frutta e verdura di alta qualità per l'industria alimentare e alimentare. Nei nostri siti di produzione Bischofszell (TG) e Burgdorf (BE), combiniamo i più elevati standard di qualità con soluzioni sostenibili e innovative – per i clienti di tutto il mondo.

- Condurre analisi chimico-fisiche e valutazioni sensoriali di materie prime, additivi e materiali ausiliari, nonché prodotti intermedi e finali

- Assumendo compiti amministrativi generali relativi alle infrastrutture di laboratorio, come la gestione di prodotti chimici, materiali di consumo e smaltimento
- Collaborazione nello sviluppo e nell'ottimizzazione dei metodi di analisi
- Organizzazione e spedizione dei campioni
- Prontezza per assegnazioni occasionali di notte e fine settimana per campionamento e campionamento di paludi

## Il tuo profilo

- Esperienza professionale nel settore alimentare
- esperienza di laboratorio e analitica; La conoscenza della tecnologia dei sensori è un vantaggio
- Metodi di lavoro precisi ed efficienti con un alto livello di consapevolezza dell'igiene secondo specifiche e standard di qualità specificati
- Buone competenze informatiche e esperienza pratica nel trattare con Microsoft Excel
- Personalità indipendente, affidabile e responsabile
- Forte lavoro di squadra e buone capacità organizzative
- Molto buone competenze tedesche in parola e scrittura, le abilità inglesi sono vantaggiose

- Emozionanti opportunità di istruzione e formazione
- 20% di sconto sui controlli REKA
- Parcheggio gratuito nelle nostre sedi

- Partecipazione all'abbonamento fitness

Ogni parte di voi è un arricchimento per il nostro mondo. Unisciti a noi e costruisci un futuro migliore insieme a noi.

With more than 17,000 employees worldwide exploring ideas and goals together, there is much to learn and many to learn from. Your talent, innovation and determination shape our future every day and positively impact billions of people. Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

**Naturex AG, a company of the Givaudan Group**, is a world-leading supplier of high-quality fruit and vegetable powders for the food and baby food industry. At our production sites Bischofszell (TG) and Burgdorf (BE), we combine the highest quality standards with sustainable and innovative solutions – for customers all over the world.

For our laboratory in **Burgdorf** we are looking for you as **Quality Assurance & Sample Technician** (m/f/d). In this versatile function, you carry out chemical-physical analyses on raw materials, additives and auxiliary materials as well as on intermediate and final products for the production of fruit and vegetable powders and thus make an important contribution to ensuring our high quality standards.

## Your tasks:

- Conducting chemico-physical analyses and sensory assessments of raw materials, additives and auxiliary materials as well as intermediate and final products
- Carrying out and managing microbiological analyses, processing samples and carrying out weekly hygiene monitoring including swabs.
- Sampling, preparation, distribution, provision and management of samples throughout the analytical process
- Independent calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment in its own work area
- Assuming general administrative tasks related to laboratory infrastructure, such as the management of chemicals, consumables and disposal
- Collaboration in the development and optimization of analysis methods
- Organisation and dispatch of samples
- Readiness for occasional night and weekend assignments for sampling and swab sampling

## Your profile

- Professional experience in the food industry
- laboratory and analytical experience; Knowledge of sensor technology is an advantage
- Precise and efficient working methods with a high level of hygiene awareness according to specified specifications and quality standards
- Good computer skills and practical experience in dealing with Microsoft Excel
- Independent, reliable and responsible personality
- Strong teamwork and good organizational skills
- Very good German skills in word and writing, English skills are advantageous

## What distinguishes Naturex?

- Exciting education and training opportunities
- 20% discount on REKA checks
- Free parking at our locations
- Various awards (Safety/Quality/Saving (Idea 499))
- Discount in the employee shop
- Top CC card
- Possibility to buy a holiday of up to 10 days per year
- 100 % of the daily sickness allowance insurance deduction
- SUVA top up insurance
- Participation in Half-Tax Subscription
- Participation in the fitness subscription
- Paid preparatory course for retirement

At Givaudan, you help create delicious taste and fragrance experiences that enrich people’s lives. We value the different perspectives that emerge from diverse cultures, backgrounds and experiences. Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. Join us and build a better future together with us.

**Naturex AG, une société du Groupe Givaudan**, est un fournisseur mondial de poudres de fruits et légumes de haute qualité pour l'industrie alimentaire et de l'alimentation pour bébés. Sur nos sites de production Bischofszell (TG) et Burgdorf (BE), nous combinons les normes de qualité les plus élevées avec des solutions durables et innovantes – pour les clients du monde entier.

Dans cette fonction polyvalente, vous effectuez des analyses chimiques-physiques sur les matières premières, les additifs et les matériaux auxiliaires ainsi que sur les produits intermédiaires et finaux pour la production de poudres de fruits et légumes et contribuez ainsi de manière importante à assurer nos normes de qualité élevées.

- Effectuer des analyses chimiques et physiques et des évaluations sensorielles des matières premières, additifs et matériaux auxiliaires ainsi que des produits intermédiaires et finaux
- Effectuer et gérer des analyses microbiologiques, traiter des échantillons et effectuer des contrôles d'hygiène hebdomadaires, y compris des prélèvements.

- Étalonnage et entretien indépendants du matériel de laboratoire dans son propre domaine de travail
- En assumant des tâches administratives générales liées à l'infrastructure des laboratoires, telles que la gestion des produits chimiques, des consommables et de l'élimination
- Collaboration dans le développement et l'optimisation des méthodes d'analyse
- Organisation et expédition des échantillons
- Préparation pour les affectations occasionnelles de nuit et de fin de semaine pour l'échantillonnage et l'échantillonnage par écouvillonnage

## Votre profil

- Expérience professionnelle dans l'industrie alimentaire
- expérience de laboratoire et d'analyse; la connaissance de la technologie des capteurs est un avantage
- Méthodes de travail précises et efficaces avec un haut niveau de sensibilisation à l'hygiène selon des spécifications et des normes de qualité spécifiées
- Bonnes compétences informatiques et expérience pratique dans le traitement de Microsoft Excel
- Personnalité indépendante, fiable et responsable
- Un travail d'équipe solide et de bonnes compétences organisationnelles
- Très bonnes compétences en allemand dans la parole et l'écriture, compétences en anglais sont avantageux

- Possibilités d'éducation et de formation intéressantes

At our production sites Bischofszell (TG) and Burgdorf (BE), we combine the highest quality standards with sustainable and innovative solutions – for customers all over the world.

## Your main tasks:

- Analysis and documentation of workflows
- Cooperation in continuous improvement projects (e.g. Pitstop)
- Accompaniment and support of ongoing productions
- Support for production planning
- General support of the production manager in day-to-day business
- Independent setup, planning, implementation and training of an AI/AI project according to the project mandate

## Your profile:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in food technology or completed training as a food technologist
- Very good PC knowledge
- Very good knowledge of German in word and writing as well as English skills are advantageous
- Enjoy spending a lot of time directly in production and getting to know processes on site
- Initial experience with AI/AI projects is an advantage (e.g. digital business or AI engineer), but no requirement

## What sets us apart in Burgdorf?

- Education and training opportunities
- 20% discount on REKA checks
- Free company parking
- Various awards (Safety/Quality/Saving(Idea 499))
- Discount in the employee shop

Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. Join us and build a better future together with us.

Nous apprécions les différentes perspectives qui émergent de diverses cultures, milieux et expériences. Toute personne – indépendamment de son appartenance ethnique, de son identité de genre, de son orientation sexuelle, de son âge, de son handicap, de sa culture, de sa religion ou de sa situation personnelle – est la bienvenue à Givaudan, un endroit où nous aimons tous être et grandir.

Chaque partie de vous est un enrichissement pour notre monde. Rejoignez-nous et construisez un avenir meilleur avec nous.

jobs.description:
Rejoignez-nous et célébrons ensemble la beauté de l’expérience humaine. Participez à la création pour des vies plus heureuses et plus saines, avec l’amour de la nature. Ensemble, avec bienveillance, humilité et l'esprit d’aventure, nous proposons des innovations pour l’alimentation, concevons des parfums inspirés et développons des solutions pour la beauté et le bien-être. Il y a tant de choses à découvrir au sein de nos 79 sites de production répartis dans le monde entier et célèbres pour leurs processus et procédures de pointe. Tant de choses à apprendre auprès de leaders brillants et de collègues attentionnés avec qui explorer vos idées et propulser vos ambitions. Chaque jour, votre énergie, votre personnalité et votre détermination façonneront notre avenir et feront la différence pour des milliards de personnes. Notre monde s’enrichit de vos différences. Nous sommes Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Agent prévention & intervention 3x8 (h/f/d) - Votre prochain emploi ?

## CDD jusqu'au 31.12.2027

En tant qu'**Agent prévention & intervention 3x8 (h/f/d)**, vous intégrerez notre département **Environnement, Hygiène et Sécurité**, et vous assurerez la prévention et l’intervention sur notre site de Vernier. Vous serez l’un des garants du respect des règles d’Environnement, d’Hygiène et de Sécurité. Vous travaillerez en horaires d’équipes 3x8 avec service de piquet régulièrement.

Ce poste vous intéresse ? Cela pourrait être l’opportunité parfaite si, comme pour nous, votre objectif est de toujours répondre aux besoins des clients et de toucher les émotions du monde qui vous entoure.

## Votre Principale mission :

## Assurer la Prévention des accidents :

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la formation des collaborateurs, sur le contrôle des activités dangereuses, ainsi que de l’entretien et de l’adaptation des équipements de prévention.

## Assurer l’Intervention :

En cas d’évènement, vous prodiguerez les premiers soins. Vous serez également responsable de l’entretien et de l’adaptation des équipements d’intervention et de protection et vous assurerez la gestion du central d’alarme. Vous contribuerez activement à la formation des Sapeurs-Pompiers volontaires internes et appliquerez les procédures et instructions Qualité liées à votre fonction.

## Vous ?

Vous voulez évoluer et façonner votre parcours professionnel à votre manière ? Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise qui favorise le travail d’équipe ? Vous désirez collaborer et apprendre avec une équipe aussi qualifiée que passionnée par leur métier ? Alors rejoignez-nous et donnez un sens à votre carrière ! Transmettez-nous votre dossier complet, CV, Lettre de motivation, diplôme !

## Votre Profil :

- Vous êtes au bénéfice d’un diplôme de Pompier ou d’une formation jugée équivalente. Vous êtes au bénéfice d'une formation de Porteur d’appareils respiratoires et d'un diplôme de secourisme BLS AED au minimum ;
- Vous possédez au moins 3 ans d'expériences dans une fonction similaire, une première expérience dans le domaine de la chimie et de la prévention est un plus ;
- Vous possédez un permis de conduire Poids lourd, Catégorie C, ou en cours de validité ;
- Vous êtes particulièrement reconnu pour votre conscience professionnelle et votre empathie ;
- Vous faites preuve de flexibilité, d'autonomie et d'un grand sens des responsabilités ;
- Vous êtes doté d'un excellent sens de la communication et de l'écoute.

Pour des raisons de sécurité et d'hygiène, nous vous prions de noter que le port de la barbe n'est pas autorisé dans les fonctions de production / Laboratoires.

De par ses activités, Givaudan est soumise à la réglementation de l’OFAC (Office Fédéral de l'Aviation Civil). Dans ce contexte, nous vous informons qu'un extrait de casier judiciaire sera requis en fin de processus de recrutement.

## Nos avantages :

- Participation à la prime d'assurance maladie
- Caisse de Pension avantageuse
- Magasin du personnel, accès à des produits Givaudan
- Activités sportives et de loisirs
- Restaurant d'entreprise avec prix réduits
- Subvention pour la mobilité

Ce challenge passionnant vous intéresse ? Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature ! Assurez-vous de joindre votre CV, lettre de motivation, diplômes et certificats de travail.

Chez Givaudan, vous contribuez à créer des expériences gustatives et olfactives qui enchantent la vie des gens. Nous valorisons les points de vue différents qui naissent de cultures, d’horizons et d’expériences variés. Chaque personne — quel que soit son origine, son identité de genre, son orientation sexuelle, son âge, ses handicaps, sa culture, sa religion ou sa situation personnelle — est chaleureusement accueillie chez Givaudan, un endroit où nous aimons être et grandir ensemble.

Notre monde s’enrichit de vos différences. Rejoignez-nous.

In questo contesto, vi informiamo che un estratto del verbale penale sarà richiesto alla fine del processo di reclutamento. ## I nostri vantaggi - Partecipazione al premio di assicurazione malattia - Fondo pensionistico beneficiario - Negozio di personale, accesso ai prodotti Givaudan - Attività sportive e ricreative - Business ristorante con prezzi scontati - Sovvenzione della mobilità Sei interessato a questa sfida emozionante? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione! Assicuratevi di allegare il vostro CV, lettera di copertura, diplomi e certificati di lavoro. A Givaudan, aiuta a creare esperienze gustose e olfattive che deliziano la vita delle persone. Apprezziamo le diverse prospettive che nascono da diverse culture, sfondi ed esperienze. Ogni persona — qualunque sia la loro origine, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, disabilità, cultura, religione o situazione personale — è calorosamente accolta a Givaudan, un luogo dove amiamo essere e crescere insieme. Il nostro mondo è arricchito dalle vostre differenze. Unisciti a noi.

Together, with benevolence, humility and adventure spirit, we propose innovations for food, design inspired fragrances and develop solutions for beauty and well-being. There are so many things to discover at our 79 production sites worldwide and famous for their cutting-edge processes and procedures. So much to learn from brilliant leaders and thoughtful colleagues with whom to explore your ideas and drive your ambitions. Every day, your energy, personality and determination will shape our future and make a difference for billions of people. Our world is enriched by your differences. We're Givaudan. Human by nature. ## Prevention and intervention agent 3x8 (h/f/d) - Your next job? ## CSD until 31.12.2027 As a prevention and intervention agent 3x8 (h/f/d), you will integrate our department Environment, Hygiene and Safety, and you will ensure prevention and intervention on our Vernier site. You will be one of the guarantors of compliance with the rules of Environment, Hygiene and Safety. You will work in 3x8 shifts with picket service regularly. You're interested in this job? This could be the perfect opportunity if, as for us, your goal is to always meet the needs of customers and touch the emotions of the world around you. ## Your Main Mission ## Ensure accident prevention You will play a key role in the training of employees, in the control of hazardous activities, and in the maintenance and adaptation of preventive equipment. ## Ensuring Intervention In case of an event, you will provide first aid. You will also be responsible for the maintenance and adaptation of response and protection equipment and you will be responsible for the management of the alarm centre. You will actively contribute to the training of internal volunteer Firefighters and will apply the Quality procedures and instructions related to your function. ## You? Want to evolve and shape your career in your own way? Do you want to integrate a company that promotes teamwork? Would you like to collaborate and learn with a team as qualified as they are passionate about their profession? Then join us and make your career meaningful! • Profile - You have a fireman's degree or equivalent training. You are in receipt of a minimum of BLS AED first aid certificate; - You have at least 3 years of experience in a similar function, a first experience in chemistry and prevention is a plus; - You have a driver's licence Heavyweight, Category C, or valid; - You are particularly well known for your professional conscience and empathy; - You show flexibility, autonomy and a great sense of responsibility; - You have an excellent sense of communication and listening. For safety and hygiene reasons, please note that wearing the beard is not allowed in the production/laboratory functions. By virtue of its activities, Givaudan is subject to the regulations of OFAC (Federal Civil Aviation Office). In this context, we inform you that an extract of the criminal record will be required at the end of the recruitment process. ## Our benefits - Participation in the sickness insurance premium - Beneficial pension fund - Personnel store, access to Givaudan products - Sports and leisure activities - Business restaurant with discounted prices - Mobility grant Are you interested in this exciting challenge? We look forward to receiving your application! Be sure to attach your CV, cover letter, diplomas and work certificates. At Givaudan, you help create taste and olfactory experiences that delight people's lives. We value the different perspectives that arise from different cultures, backgrounds and experiences. Every person — whatever their origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion or personal situation — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we love to be and grow together. Our world is enriched by your differences. Join us.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Begleiten Sie uns und feiern Sie gemeinsam die Schönheit der menschlichen Erfahrung. Beteiligen Sie sich an der Schöpfung für ein glücklicheres und gesünderes Leben mit der Liebe zur Natur. Gemeinsam mit Wohlwollen, Demut und Abenteuergeist schlagen wir Innovationen für Lebensmittel vor, designen inspirierte Düfte und entwickeln Lösungen für Schönheit und Wohlbefinden. Es gibt so viel zu entdecken an unseren 79 Produktionsstätten weltweit und berühmt für ihre innovativen Prozesse und Verfahren. Es gibt so viel zu lernen von brillanten Führungskräften und nachdenklichen Kollegen, mit denen Sie Ihre Ideen erkunden und Ihre Ambitionen vorantreiben können. Jeden Tag werden Ihre Energie, Persönlichkeit und Entschlossenheit unsere Zukunft prägen und für Milliarden von Menschen einen Unterschied machen. Unsere Welt wird durch Ihre Unterschiede bereichert. Wir sind Givaudan. Menschlich von Natur aus. ## Prävention und Intervention Agent 3x8 (h / f / d) - Ihr nächster Job? ## CSD bis 31.12.2027 Als Präventions- und Interventionsmittel 3x8 (h/w/d) integrieren Sie unsere Abteilung Umwelt, Hygiene und Sicherheit und sorgen für Prävention und Intervention auf unserem Vernier-Standort. Sie werden einer der Garanten für die Einhaltung der Regeln für Umwelt, Hygiene und Sicherheit sein. Sie werden in 3x8 Schichten mit Streikposten-Service regelmäßig arbeiten. Sie interessieren sich für diesen Job? Dies könnte die perfekte Gelegenheit sein, wenn es für uns Ihr Ziel ist, immer die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu erfüllen und die Emotionen der Welt um Sie herum zu berühren. ## Deine Hauptmission ## Unfallverhütung sicherstellen Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Schulung der Mitarbeiter, bei der Kontrolle gefährlicher Aktivitäten und bei der Wartung und Anpassung von Präventivgeräten. ## Sicherstellung der Intervention Im Falle einer Veranstaltung werden Sie Erste Hilfe leisten. Sie sind auch für die Wartung und Anpassung der Reaktions- und Schutzausrüstung sowie für die Verwaltung der Alarmzentrale verantwortlich. Sie werden aktiv zur Ausbildung von internen freiwilligen Feuerwehrleuten beitragen und die Qualitätsverfahren und -anweisungen in Bezug auf Ihre Funktion anwenden. ## Sie? Möchten Sie sich weiterentwickeln und Ihre Karriere auf Ihre eigene Weise gestalten? Möchten Sie ein Unternehmen integrieren, das Teamarbeit fördert? Möchten Sie mit einem Team zusammenarbeiten und lernen, das so qualifiziert ist, wie es sich für seinen Beruf begeistert? Dann kommen Sie zu uns und machen Sie Ihre Karriere sinnvoll! Geben Sie uns Ihre vollständige Datei, CV, Motivationsschreiben, Diplom! ##
• Ihr Profil - Sie haben einen Feuerwehrgrad oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung. Sie erhalten mindestens ein BLS AED Erste-Hilfe-Zertifikat; - Sie haben mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion, eine erste Erfahrung in Chemie und Prävention ist ein Plus; - Sie haben einen Führerschein Schwergewicht, Kategorie C oder gültig; - Sie sind besonders bekannt für Ihr professionelles Gewissen und Empathie; - Sie zeigen Flexibilität, Autonomie und ein großes Verantwortungsbewusstsein; - Sie haben ein ausgezeichnetes Gefühl der Kommunikation und des Zuhörens. Aus Sicherheits- und Hygienegründen beachten Sie bitte, dass das Tragen des Bartes in den Produktions-/Laborfunktionen nicht erlaubt ist. Aufgrund seiner Aktivitäten unterliegt Givaudan den Vorschriften des OFAC (Federal Civil Aviation Office). In diesem Zusammenhang informieren wir Sie, dass am Ende des Rekrutierungsprozesses ein Auszug aus dem Strafregister erforderlich ist. ## Unsere Vorteile - Beteiligung an der Krankenversicherungsprämie - Begünstigter Pensionsfonds - Personalladen, Zugang zu Givaudan Produkten - Sport- und Freizeitaktivitäten - Business Restaurant mit ermäßigten Preisen - Mobilitätszuschuss Sie interessieren sich für diese spannende Herausforderung? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie Ihren Lebenslauf, Ihr Anschreiben, Ihre Diplome und Ihre Arbeitsbescheinigungen beifügen. Bei Givaudan tragen Sie dazu bei, Geschmacks- und Geruchserlebnisse zu schaffen, die das Leben der Menschen erfreuen. Wir schätzen die unterschiedlichen Perspektiven, die sich aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen, Hintergründen und Erfahrungen ergeben. Jeder Mensch - unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Kultur, Religion oder persönlicher Situation - wird in Givaudan herzlich willkommen geheißen, einem Ort, an dem wir gerne zusammen sind und wachsen. Unsere Welt wird durch Ihre Unterschiede bereichert. Begleiten Sie uns.

Insieme, con gentilezza, umiltà e spirito di avventura, proponiamo innovazioni per il cibo, profumi ispirati al design e sviluppiamo soluzioni per la bellezza e il benessere. C'è così tanto da scoprire nei nostri 79 siti produttivi in ​​tutto il mondo, famosi per i loro processi e procedure all'avanguardia. C'è così tanto da imparare da leader brillanti e colleghi premurosi con cui esplorare le tue idee e promuovere le tue ambizioni. Ogni giorno, la tua energia, personalità e determinazione daranno forma al nostro futuro e faranno la differenza per miliardi di persone. Il nostro mondo è arricchito dalle vostre differenze. Siamo Givaudan. Umano per natura. Analista del controllo qualità (m/f/d) - Il tuo prossimo lavoro? In qualità di Analista del Controllo Qualità (m/f/d), farai parte del nostro dipartimento di Controllo Qualità e riferirai al nostro Supervisore del Controllo Qualità. Nel cuore del controllo qualità, effettuerete valutazioni con una forte dimensione olfattiva, garantendo la conformità e l'eccellenza dei nostri prodotti. Ti occuperai di valutare, controllare e analizzare gli ingredienti e i prodotti finiti della profumeria eseguendo controlli olfattivi associati a test fisico-chimici e analitici al fine di garantire la conformità agli standard, alle specifiche e alla sicurezza del prodotto. Sei interessato a questa posizione? Questa potrebbe essere l'occasione perfetta se, come noi, il tuo obiettivo è soddisfare sempre le esigenze dei clienti e toccare le emozioni del mondo che ti circonda. Unsere Welt wird durch Ihre Unterschiede bereichert. Givaudan setzt sich für Chancengleichheit ein. Daher akzeptieren wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Geschlechtsidentität. Wir haben auch ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld, fortschrittliche Arbeitsbedingungen und sind als Arbeitgeber zertifiziert, der gleiche Löhne für Männer und Frauen garantiert.
